settings.title: Settings
settings.maxIsland: Sentences per island (also the auto-split limit)
settings.maxIslandHint: 8–10 recommended for beginners — finishable in a day without burying you in reviews. When a generated scene exceeds this, it auto-splits into smaller sub-islands.
settings.apiTokenHint: The ECHO_API_TOKEN set on the server; used for compose / gloss / TTS calls.
settings.apiBaseHint: Leave blank to use the default. Set only for local dev or a different server.
settings.backupHint: Export all your islands, sentences and review progress to a file and keep it safe. Local data can't be recovered once lost — audio isn't included (it regenerates from text).
settings.importDone: Imported: {islands} islands, {sentences} sentences, {reviews} review records. Refresh to see them.
settings.advancedSection: Advanced (backend connection · not needed for normal use)
settings.routingHint: Switch the provider / model for each AI task — applies live, no restart. Leave model blank for the provider's default. Keys stay server-side.

einbuergerung.title: German Citizenship Test
einbuergerung.subtitle: Leben in Deutschland · 310 questions (300 national + 10 NRW)
einbuergerung.loadError: Failed to load questions. Please refresh.
einbuergerung.examHint: 33 random questions (30 national + 3 NRW), pass at 17 correct, timed.
einbuergerung.tagHelp_negation: Stem has nicht / kein / keine → pick the 'odd/bad' answer; the logic is inverted.
einbuergerung.tagHelp_number: Answer is a number/year/age/percentage → memorise the number anchor.
einbuergerung.tagHelp_values: Answer is about freedom/democracy/equality/human dignity → favour these when unsure.
einbuergerung.tagHelp_image: Pick by image number — pure visual memory, easy points.
einbuergerung.tagHelp_matching: Ordinary question — match stem anchor ↔ answer anchor.
